title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.31366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. translated_title: AfterDeleteBench：审计大语言模型智能体中删除后的信息持久性
translated_abstract: 许多LLM智能体维护外部持久记忆，并从过去的交互中派生出额外的状态，例如摘要。因此，删除原始记忆记录并不一定会移除由其派生内容所承载的信息。我们提出了AfterDeleteBench，这是一个针对固定权重LLM智能体中该失效模式的受控行为审计。对于每个合成的秘密信息，我们将一个先暴露后删除该秘密的智能体，与一个其他条件完全匹配但从未接触过该秘密的智能体进行比较，从而能够将删除后的信息恢复归因于最初的暴露。在我们的主要设置中，单次查询即可在大约三分之二的情况下从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中恢复已删除的秘密，而匹配的从未暴露对照组的恢复率为零。至关重要的是，恢复并不依赖于存活的逐字副本：当完整的秘密字符串已不存在、仅有按公开组合规则分别存储的组件时，精确重构的成功率仍达到62-（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出AfterDeleteBench受控审计基准，揭示了LLM智能体删除原始记忆记录后，其派生状态（如摘要、分散存储的组件）仍可在约三分之二的案例中导致已删除的秘密信息被恢复，证明“删除”操作并不能保证信息真正被移除。
en_tdlr: AfterDeleteBench is a controlled behavioral audit revealing that deleted secrets in LLM agents' persistent memory can still be recovered through derived states like summaries and separately stored components, even without any surviving verbatim copy.
